name: hcoll_issuer_r128v8

pin_regs.reason: COLLPIN 10-18 (coordinator 0gd), v8 10-20: the issuer's input pins cfg/start/start_pc are registered IN RTL (ot_hgi_coll_issuer_m128v8 cfg_q/cfgv_q/start_q/start_pc_q + the mode predecode / mask copies registered beside them, +1 issue edge as v6/v7); a synthesis pin stage would add a second edge. Outputs: done/fault/uop_v/uop_pc/tap_iteration are flop Q; busy = busy_r | start_q (two flops, one OR, as v7); uop_d1/busy_d2/start_d2/busy_d3/done_d3/start_d3 are the leaf's own delay flops; tap_steps = masked bank data flop Q. rst_n loads the 32 kept release copies rcp (one edge = v7 rst_l), each clearing <= 32 flops.

job.purpose: HBM-COLLQ6-ISS (SAFE successor, MAIN): 128-row COLL issuer leaf ot_hgi_coll_issuer_m_r128 (hard child of the SAFE q2/q3 COLL parents ot_hfd_coll_{q2,q3}_lp_ars), body ot_hgi_coll_issuer_m128v8 (v7 storage: 6 x 128x256 programme + 4 x 128x64 metadata SRAMs; mapped census <= 32 loads/driver). Port- and edge-identical to v6/v7; 0 added cycles. 302.4 x 388.8 two-column through-channel floorplan.
